title: Session: 2.36.0 the simple pipeline
objective: 2.36.0 (#62) moves staging onto the simple pipeline: OpenTofu builds the VM, cloud-init sets its keys, Ansible from a GitHub runner configures it and deploys the bot, and GitHub environments hold the secrets. There is no bot change and no migration; production keeps its Compose path.

After merging: create the infra environment, run the import-only apply, build staging, pin its host key, then configure and preflight it.
assistant: Build DevBot at 2.36.0 (no migration, no bot change), register the guild commands, and confirm 21 roots and 47 paths.
Read the staging runs' logs (read-only), grep them for names, addresses and secrets, and record the verification.
bot: Run 2.35.0 in production until the 2.36.0 deploy; nothing changes for members.
